ResearchProjectDef.label: Fueled turbine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a wood powered turbojet generator. Although cumbersome, it produces a lot power. Must be refueled by hand.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Chemfuel turbine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a chemfuel powered turbojet. Although cumbersome, it produces a lot of power, and can be refueled by chemfuel pipes.
